Quote from Head of ML: 'We need predictable 99th pctl latency for short chat turns; can't have spikes during peak support hours.'

requirements_summary: Goal: Replace current search+FAQ stack with LLM-backed support agent and semantic search. Start with Hosted API POC for speed; if metrics (latency, cost per ticket, recall) meet thresholds, transition to Dedicated with VPC. Must satisfy SOC2, SSO via Okta/SAML, 12mo audit log retention, AWS KMS integration, and US data residency.
latency_targets: p50 < 120ms for short chat responses; p95 < 400ms; aim p99 < 800ms
throughput_targets: baseline 40 requests/sec with ability to burst to 150 req/sec during business hours
poc_details: POC scope: support-agent + doc-search across 120k docs (docs preprocessed to embeddings)
Success metrics: avg cost per resolved ticket, top-3 retrieval recall, latency p95 <= 400ms
Data handling: PII redaction pre-send; embeddings stored in customer DB during evaluation
Duration: 2 weeks hosted POC (completed), follow-on Dedicated trial planned for 30 days
